WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    r.r_reason_desc,
    ws.ws_quantity,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    wr.wr_refunded_cash,
    wr.wr_fee,
    cd1.cd_marital_status AS cd1_marital_status,
    cd1.cd_education_status AS cd1_education_status,
    ca.ca_state
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN web_returns wr
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
   AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
  JOIN web_page wp
    ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  JOIN date_dim d
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
  JOIN reason r
    ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 1998
    AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
    AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC','TX','IA','WI','WV','GA','OK','VA','KY')
    AND (
      (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary')
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College')
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
    )
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
)
SELECT
  substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
  avg(ws_quantity),
  avg(wr_refunded_cash),
  avg(wr_fee)
FROM (
  SELECT
    j.r_reason_desc,
    j.ws_quantity,
    j.wr_refunded_cash,
    j.wr_fee
  FROM joined j
  JOIN (VALUES
    ('D','Primary',100.00,150.00,'NC','TX','IA',100,200),
    ('D','Primary',100.00,150.00,'WI','WV','GA',150,300),
    ('D','Primary',100.00,150.00,'OK','VA','KY',50,250),
    ('S','College',50.00,100.00,'NC','TX','IA',100,200),
    ('S','College',50.00,100.00,'WI','WV','GA',150,300),
    ('S','College',50.00,100.00,'OK','VA','KY',50,250),
    ('U','Advanced Degree',150.00,200.00,'NC','TX','IA',100,200),
    ('U','Advanced Degree',150.00,200.00,'WI','WV','GA',150,300),
    ('U','Advanced Degree',150.00,200.00,'OK','VA','KY',50,250)
  ) AS v(marital, education, min_price, max_price, st1, st2, st3, min_profit, max_profit)
    ON j.cd1_marital_status = v.marital
   AND j.cd1_education_status = v.education
   AND j.ws_sales_price BETWEEN v.min_price AND v.max_price
   AND j.ca_state IN (v.st1, v.st2, v.st3)
   AND j.ws_net_profit BETWEEN v.min_profit AND v.max_profit
) AS matched
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
